1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Jun 2011.

Pindaan Jadual

2. (1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] dipinda dalam

butiran 15 Jadual dengan menggantikan peta dalam Jadual dengan peta yang berikut:

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA SENAI-PASIR GUDANG-DESARU

Dibuat 3 Jun 2011

[ [KKR. PUU.110-1/7/26;PN(PU2)460/LXIII]

]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 June 2011.

Amendment of Schedule

2. (1) The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] is amended in item 15

of the Schedule by substituting for the map in the Schedule the following map:

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF SENAI-PASIR GUDANG-DESARU EXPRESSWAY

Made 3 June 2011

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/26; PN(PU2)460/LXIII]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

Minister of Transport
